Priya Desai: Hi team 1st day! My M2 Air arrived and I'm in the setup flow. Kandji installer says 'enrollment failed: certificate validation' and FileVault never triggered. Any quick tips?

Lena (IT): welcome Priya :wave: Can you paste the exact error from the installer dialog or from Console.app logs? Sometimes it's CTK (certificate transparency) related.

Priya Desai: screenshot shows 'MDM enrollment error: certificate chain validation failed (err: -9806)'. In Console I see 'MDM: SCEP renewal failed, http error 0'. I'm on home network behind a Peplink router.

Ethan R.: That http 0 often means the SCEP server callback couldn't reach the device. Can you try tethering to phone or join a different network briefly? Also check date/time is correct.

Priya Desai: Date/time is fine. Tethered to phone and re-ran installer, same error.

Lena (IT): Thanks. Two paths: 1) We can push a short-lived bypass (temp local admin + enrollment override) and finish profile install; 2) If you prefer to avoid admin, we can generate a one-time SCEP enroll token for manual import. Which do you want?

Priya Desai: Prefer temp admin so I can finish remaining setup (brew, VS Code). How do I request?

Lena (IT): Please open RD help ticket with device serial and preferred UTC window. We'll need to whitelist your device for SCEP during the window and temporarily allow system extensions for rosetta/CLI tools.

Priya Desai: Created ticket RD-3589, serial C02X9YZZZZ, window 20:30-21:30 UTC.

kandji-bot: Webhook received for C02X9YZZZZ 1 queued for enrollment.

Lena (IT): Approved. We set a 1hr temp-admin window 20:30-21:30 UTC. You'll receive an MDM prompt to accept the profile; please keep VPN off unless we ask. We'll revoke admin at the end.

Priya Desai: Quick question 5: will FileVault recovery key be escrowed automatically or do I need to set a passphrase?

Ethan R.: Kandji FileVault payload will prompt you to enable disk encryption and then escrow the key to our key store automatically once the profile completes. You won't need to memorize the key.

DevEx Bot: FYI: If you need Rosetta or CLI helpers, request the com.apple.rosetta system extension pre-approval code and we'll allow it for the enrollment window.

Lena (IT): Done 5 preapproved com.apple.rosetta and com.apple.pkg.CLTools for RD-3589 window. Also pushing a temporary CA trust so the CTK chain verifies.

Priya Desai: Enrollment succeeded inside the window! Kandji shows 'Device enrolled' and FileVault prompt popped. Escrow message in Kandji dashboard says 'recovery key stored'. I was able to install Homebrew and `brew install git`. Thanks.

Ethan R.: Welcome Priya :tada: Ping me for repo invites and a quick pairing slot. Also if you see any prompts about kernel extensions, grab a screenshot and drop it here.

Priya Desai: All good, no kernel extension prompts. Appreciate the fast turnaround, Lena!!

Lena (IT): Glad it worked. We've revoked the temp admin and cleared the enrollment override. Closing RD-3589 now. If anything weird shows up (random password prompts), DM me.

Priya Desai: Will do 44D Thanks team!
